offers_products.reason: Sells branded over-the-counter healthcare products like Monistat, Clear Eyes, Dramamine, BC Powder and Compound W.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from OTC consumer healthcare brands; no services are offered as a main business.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Consumers choose its OTC brands such as Clear Eyes, Monistat and Dramamine in stores.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Brands are sold through retailers such as pharmacies and mass merchants, which buy the goods for resale.

recurring_revenue.reason: Low-cost OTC remedies such as eye drops, pain powders and throat drops are bought repeatedly by the same shoppers and retailers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Demand is for health remedies like pain relief, heartburn and infection treatment, which people buy in any economy.

big_ticket.reason: Products such as lozenges, eye drops and pain powders are small, frequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: It sells branded packaged goods; staff time is not what customers pay for.

large_customers.reason: End buyers are households, so this is a consumer business, though retailers are large.

asset_heavy.reason: Brand-focused OTC company that relies on third-party manufacturers, so it needs little plant or fleet investment.

notes: Large retail chains are the direct buyers, but shoppers choose the brands. Asset-light status is based on my background knowledge of its outsourced manufacturing.
